label: Mecca, Saudi Arabia
sub: Signing site of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, Aug 7, 2026

label: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
sub: Capital; site of the original SMDA signing at Al-Yamamah Palace, Sep 17 2025; confirmed Aug 31, 2026 as the Mecca Defence Alliance's permanent secretariat, to be led by Pakistan's first secretary-general for a three-year term. On Sep 10, 2026, senior Pakistani and Turkish military officials met Saudi counterparts here to coordinate a response to the Houthi escalation, agreeing any action would launch from Saudi territory rather than send troops into Yemen.

label: Islamabad, Pakistan
sub: Capital of founding signatory Pakistan, the pact's only nuclear-armed member

label: Ankara, Turkey
sub: Capital of founding signatory Turkey, a NATO member bringing advanced defense-industrial capacity

label: Istanbul, Turkey
sub: Site of the first Strategic Political and Defence Committee meeting, Aug 31, 2026, where officials formally named the pact the "Mecca Defence Alliance" and confirmed a Riyadh secretariat led by a Pakistani secretary-general

label: Prince Sultan Air Base
sub: Struck repeatedly by Iran during the 2026 war (Mar 1 & Mar 27); hosted Pakistani JF-17s, drone squadrons and an HQ-9 battery deployed under the SMDA

label: Tehran, Iran
sub: Iran dismisses the pact as a "paper agreement" while calling for broader Muslim unity; an Aug 23 claim that Tehran was invited to join was denied by the Foreign Ministry a day later, which said only informal dialogue proposals had been raised

label: Tel Aviv, Israel
sub: Senior Israeli official: pact "worries us" and is "aimed at Israel"; Netanyahu reportedly floats a "Hexagon Alliance" counter-initiative. FM Sa'ar says Israel won't accept Turkish bases in Syria but seeks no escalation; Mossad chief met Syria's FM in Jordan Aug 23 to keep Turkey-Israel friction off Syrian soil

label: Abu Dhabi, UAE
sub: UAE intelligence caught off guard, learning of the pact only two weeks before signing; by mid-August, commentator Abdulkhaleq Abdulla's mocking post about Pakistan's economy sparked online backlash and exposed continued Gulf unease over the pact

label: New Delhi, India
sub: MEA says it is "closely following" the pact and expects Riyadh to weigh India's interests; analysts see a setback given Pakistan's elevated regional standing

label: Cairo, Egypt
sub: Turkey's Fidan calls Egypt a "natural partner" for accession, but Saudi sources tell Middle East Eye Riyadh — not Cairo — blocked Egypt's entry, citing weak reciprocal support and Cairo's ties to the UAE

label: Doha, Qatar
sub: Named among Gulf states "close to all three signatories" and seen as a plausible future accession candidate; site of the Sep 2025 Israeli strike that helped trigger the original SMDA

label: Kuwait City, Kuwait
sub: Named alongside Qatar as a Gulf state close to all three signatories and seeking security reassurance

label: Manama, Bahrain
sub: Cited among other GCC members as a potential future accession candidate

label: Amman, Jordan
sub: Analysts identify Jordan as a country that could accede "relatively quickly" given existing ties to signatories

label: Damascus, Syria
sub: Named by analysts alongside Jordan and Azerbaijan as a plausible near-term accession candidate

label: Abu al-Duhur Air Base, Syria
sub: Israel strikes the base days after a Turkish delegation visited to assess rehabilitating it; Netanyahu's office cites Turkish troop deployment near Aleppo — analysts tie the episode to Mecca-pact-driven Turkey-Israel friction. Turkey denies troops were present; Syria confirms only a visit. Aug 23: Mossad chief and Syria's FM met in Jordan to keep the dispute from spilling further onto Syrian soil

label: Strait of Hormuz (near Khasab, Oman)
sub: Saudi-flagged tanker Sidr and Liberian-flagged Senegal Prosperity struck by unknown projectiles late Aug 31, killing two Filipino sailors aboard the Sidr per Saudi Arabia — the first attack on a Saudi asset since the Mecca pact's signing, with no invocation or joint response yet from Pakistan or Turkey

label: Khamis Mushait / Abha, Saudi Arabia
sub: Houthi ballistic missiles and drones hit King Khalid Air Base and Aramco facilities across Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran on Sep 8, wounding 73 — called the Mecca pact's first real test; Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif says aggression against any signatory would draw a joint response, but no military action has been taken as of Sep 9

label: Al-Hazm, Yemen
sub: Saudi-backed coalition airstrike hits a Houthi-run prison here Sep 9, killing 23 including a child, as coalition forces sharply escalate retaliation for the Sep 8 Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia — part of roughly 32 further strikes across Marib, Al-Jawf, Taiz and Hodeidah reported overnight into Sep 10; none of the pact's non-Saudi signatories has joined militarily

label: Mayyun Island / Bab al-Mandeb Strait, Yemen
sub: Houthi forces capture the port of Mocha (Sep 10) and Mayyun (Perim) Island plus the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands (Sep 11), taking effective control of both channels of the Bab al-Mandeb strait — a chokepoint for roughly 12% of global trade — and opening a new front as the Mecca pact's signatories weigh a joint response

label: Sharurah, Saudi Arabia
sub: Houthi drones and ballistic missiles strike the Sharurah military base on Sep 13, with a projectile also falling near the border wounding two and damaging a mosque; Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree warns of "bigger strikes deeper" inside the kingdom if attacks on Yemen continue

label: King Khalid Air Base, Khamis Mushait
sub: Houthis claim a large-scale missile-and-drone attack on King Khalid Air Base on Sep 14, saying "dozens" of ballistic missiles and drones hit aircraft hangars, radar sites, runways and ammunition depots; Saudi Civil Defence issued and then lifted an alert, with Riyadh not confirming damage or casualties — the largest claimed strike on Saudi soil since Sep 8, with no Pakistani or Turkish military involvement

label: Khamis Mushait / Abha / Taif, Saudi Arabia
sub: Houthi missile-and-drone barrage wounds 13, Sep 15, 2026

label: Mecca, Saudi Arabia
sub: Coalition intercepts Houthi drone before it enters restricted airspace, Sep 16, 2026 — first alert since 2017

label: Taif, Saudi Arabia
sub: Houthi drone intercepted Sep 17, 2026; interception killed 1, injured 2
